Montgomery for being L. W. Montgomery, against identity.json's own two_houses ruling), which in turn wants T-0009's roofs because South Water Street is out of supply. Both of the paper's own anchors are exhausted: the town holds no Carver building and can hold none, and J. Wright's two buildings stand at invented positions on Randolph Street. The ticket's stated prerequisite - an anchor that refuses ambiguity instead of taking the first - shipped in this PR.
